description:
Execution boundary: planning approved; this issue does not authorize commits, pushes, merges, upstream publication, GitHub comments, live WhatsApp access, or real messages. Revalidate current source/Git state before implementation. Preserve unrelated work, including the already-edited docs/architecture.md. Track this work in the ZAQ Beadwork store even when files belong to the sibling package; do not initialize another store.
Read AGENTS.md in the affected repository. For ZAQ read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the domain policies listed below. Read module documentation before editing. Source navigation uses Serena with bounded fallback if unavailable. Record test results honestly; plan approval is not completed-feature UX approval. Follow repository validation owners; no assertion weakening or unrelated refactors. Existing test changes outside the specifically approved contracts need human approval.

Required domain policies: ../jido_chat_whatsapp/AGENTS.md and docs/adapter_contracts.md. Recheck ../jido_chat existing contracts read-only.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Repository: ../jido_chat_whatsapp. Owner lib/jido_chat_whatsapp/adapter.ex. Add package-specific optional extension cleanup_connection(binding, opts) -> :ok | {:error, atom}; it is NOT a new Jido.Chat.Adapter behaviour callback and must not be marked @impl against jido_chat. Keep jido_chat at its existing shared-contract commit.
For a non-nil opaque binding reuse connection_options(binding, opts) to derive trusted Split/profile config; require valid trusted sink_mfa. For existing non-binding File/custom configurations, binding nil is allowed ONLY with explicit trusted nonempty profile and the established connection/storage opts; this follows connection_options(nil, opts), not implicit default-profile guessing. Preserve configured transport selection and dispatch offline cleanup through the optional Transport cleanup capability from zaq-e5z.2. Never interpret host binding fields, provision credentials via :bind, hardcode ZAQ IDs/schema, or invoke Amarula directly from adapter-level orchestration.
Validate missing/invalid profile/options/sink and unsupported transport before side effects; sanitize exceptions/timeouts. Use a bounded callback execution convention compatible with existing package patterns; timeout is uncertain completion, never auto-retry destructive operations. Existing runtime logout remains for running listeners. Ordinary stop still preserves storage. The host must exclude startup/writes until its disable persistence and runtime shutdown finish; document that precondition rather than starting a package-wide orchestrator.
Retain credential association and stable profile; clear only selected records. Split's partial durable/RAM failure remains error and explicit retry is supported. An absent/unready required store is failure, not presumed empty.

Tests to add before implementation:
Add adapter contract tests using real transport cleanup + isolated storage: non-nil host binding, nil binding with trusted File/custom/prebuilt config, missing profile/sink/options rejected, unsupported transport returns error, exact arguments retained, no listener/connection startup, no bind provisioning, no secret error output, repeat clear and account isolation. Run full default non-live package suite and mix quality per package policy after both package issues are implemented. Browser E2E not applicable here.

Branches/paths validated:
Bound and standalone storage configurations, bad input, unsupported transport, success, partial failure, explicit retry, no process/network creation.

Mocking plan:
Existing fake host sink is external to the package; real profile/storage/transport boundary implementation. Only network transport calls fake; no live WhatsApp. Isolate default config and global Mnesia state.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Public @doc/@spec and docs/adapter_contracts.md explicitly call this a package extension discoverable on the configured adapter, explain trusted inputs, absence of remote-unlink guarantee and host exclusion requirement. README example for offline cleanup.

Action reuse assessment:
Decision: new local package extension reusing connection_options, Transport cleanup, Split and shared Storage.Request(:clear). Shared logout/1 is listener-only; authenticate(:cancel) targets a provisional session; shutdown retains credentials. Do not overload those contracts, add a shared core callback, or call concrete Split from ZAQ. No new host storage op/envelope, agent exposure or workflow step. Explicit binding/trusted options -> idempotent selected-profile clear or atom error. Verify authorization through the sink and generic backend dispatch.

comments.text: Added package-specific Adapter.cleanup_connection/2 without changing jido_chat behaviour. Non-nil bindings require valid trusted sink and derive canonical Split/profile; standalone File/custom/prebuilt opts remain supported. No :bind, no direct credential reads or transport connection. Optional configured Transport cleanup, sanitized results/exceptions, bounded task timeout with uncertain-completion error; host authorization remains in callback. New tests prove unauthorized callback retains RAM, profile override cannot change bound identity, standalone backends, unsupported transport and killed timeout task. Full non-live package suite: 216 tests, 13 properties, 0 failures (13 live excluded). mix quality passes (Dialyzer 0 errors/Doctor 0 failed). Package README/contracts updated. All changes remain uncommitted.
